model: RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=500, random_state=42) on 8 clinical features (followup_score excluded)
notes: Stratified 80/20 split (random_state=42). followup_score was excluded because it almost perfectly separates the outcome (likely recorded after diagnosis); including it gives 0.927 test accuracy, which is leakage. Zero values in glucose/insulin/etc. were kept as-is.
